drawings.description: croquis en marge gauche, rattaché à « NB » par un trait : deux flèches parallèles $G_\rho \rightrightarrows G_\rho$ marquées $\bar f, \bar g$, une flèche montante de $\pi_1(X)$ vers le premier $G_\rho$, et une courbe sans tête de $\pi_1(X)$ au second
drawings.notes: Two parallel arrows G_rho => G_rho marked bar f, bar g, an arrow going up from pi_1(X) to the first G_rho, and a headless curve from pi_1(X) to the second. The stroke tying the sketch to « NB » passes through the crop (vertical stroke above the second G_rho, horizontal stroke to its right); only its part inside the crop is drawn, in pencil. The bars of bar f and bar g are written as two short strokes above the letters.
